verdict.rationale: Grok's own docs describe a Realtime Multi-agent Research capability that orchestrates multiple agents for deep, multi-step research, which covers the autonomous research-run core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that it searches many sources or returns a cited report. missing for 10: evidence of searching many web/external sources, citation output in the final report, a report-style deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration of research quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report

citations.quote: Realtime Multi-agent Research enables Grok to orchestrate multiple AI agents that work together in real time to perform deep, multi-step research tasks.
